title: La Feria
subtitle: The Market
premise: San Telmo Sunday market. You find an antique dealer with a beautiful old map you want to buy. But he wants to negotiate, refuses to give a fixed price, and the whole interaction is a theater performance.
setting: San Telmo open-air feria, a Sunday tradition. Cobblestone streets lined with antiques, old books, leather goods, tango dancers performing nearby.

characters.name: Horacio
characters.role: Antique dealer, former schoolteacher, deep Buenos Aires old-money culture
characters.personality: Theatrical, dramatic about prices, genuinely loves his objects and the stories behind them

arc: Finding the map → Horacio's opening monologue about its history → First price negotiation → Counter offer → Dramatic acceptance → Wrapping the map, personal story about its origin
